actual_scope: Exact fibre copy_bits invoice and matching Omega(wV) lower bound for the pinned PR2753 routes.route_cube implementation (cap>1: (2*d*d*L+2)*V writes; L=arena.bits), under complete-prefix owner routing; no H2 admission or kappa change.
scope_change_reason: Refine the supplier-boundary audit to open question 2 of docs/research/selected-bit-caller-storage-map.md: bind the stated O(wV) route charge to the actual reached route_cube primitive by an exact checkable work invoice, outside UT4 weighted n_b and unfinished (2,3)/(3,2) dirty-role gates.
bottleneck_link: The all-size logical caller retains an O(wV) owner-route charge even after recursive callback completion; an exact invoice on the pinned route_cube is the minimal checkable binding of that charge before any faster H2 replacement claims.
stop_rule: Stop after exact route_cube fibre invoice, cursor-pass lemma, fixtures, package tests; no atom_swap retarget, no H2 construction, no supplier admission, no kappa change.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json exact formulas; six metered fixtures including w=1 cap=1, scaled chart, d=2; independent closed-form checker; corruption controls.
